statement: let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); ∀ S : Finset ℕ, (∀ p ∈ S, Nat.Prime p) → let Q := ∏ p ∈ S, p; (((Finset.range Q).filter (fun n => Nat.Coprime (n^2+1) Q)).card : ℝ) / Q = ∏ p ∈ S, (1-((roots 1 p).card : ℝ)/p)
